strengths: Fits playful royal castle aesthetic easily
High production feasibility with standard 3D assets
concerns: Generic personal moment lacks high-stakes urgency for an ad hook
Requires adding an extra crisis element (like a cake fire) to create a natural transition to gameplay
adaptation_idea: King Robert celebrates his birthday with a giant cake, but blowing out the candles accidentally sets the royal banner on fire. Players must match puzzle tiles to extinguish the flames and save the birthday feast.
